name: TAN-67
summary: TAN-67 (SB-205,607) is an opioid drug used in scientific research that acts as a potent and selective δ-opioid agonist, selective for the δ1 subtype. It has analgesic properties and induces dopamine release in nucleus accumbens.

pharmacology.text: TAN-67 (SB-205,607) is an opioid drug used in scientific research that acts as a potent and selective δ-opioid agonist, selective for the δ1 subtype.

uses.text: TAN-67 (SB-205,607) is an opioid drug used in scientific research that acts as a potent and selective δ-opioid agonist, selective for the δ1 subtype.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Some delta opioid agonists have caused seizures in animals.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。部分δ鴉片受體促效劑曾在動物身上引發癲癇。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。部分δ鸦片受体促效剂曾在动物身上引发癫痫。

fact.en: Delta opioid agonists such as TAN-67 have been studied for protecting the heart from damage when its blood supply is cut off, a very different use from that of ordinary painkilling opioids.
fact.zh: TAN-67這類δ鴉片受體促效劑曾被研究用於保護心臟，避免在血液供應中斷時受損，這與一般作為止痛用的鴉片類藥物用途大不相同。
fact.zhHans: TAN-67这类δ鸦片受体促效剂曾被研究用于保护心脏，避免在血液供应中断时受损，这与一般作为止痛用的鸦片类药物用途大不相同。
